source: iRacing track models (SimRacingSetup 26S4 telemetry, owner's iRacing data, personal use): position where LapDistPct wraps from 1 to 0, interpolated between the 60 Hz samples, median over the crossings. Checked on 15 F1 tracks against the F1-timing start of the simulator: median 32 m earlier, range -80 to 0 m (Imola and Montreal excluded: layout or pose). Used only where the start was not verified. Entries whose source does not start with "iRacing" come from elsewhere (satellite image of the painted line, OpenStreetMap) and say so.

bathurst.source: iRacing start/finish line (bathurst; 53 crossings, spread 0.4 m)

motegi.source: iRacing start/finish line (twinring fullrc, Full Road Course; 87 crossings, spread 0.2 m)

okayama.source: iRacing start/finish line (okayama full, Full Course; 55 crossings, spread 0.2 m)

oschersleben.source: iRacing start/finish line (oschersleben gp, Grand Prix; 22 crossings, spread 0.4 m)

phillip-island.source: iRacing start/finish line (phillipisland; 16 crossings, spread 0.3 m)

sebring.source: iRacing start/finish line (sebring international, International; 59 crossings, spread 0.4 m)

sonoma.source: iRacing start/finish line (sonoma 2025 nascarlong, NASCAR Long; 101 crossings, spread 0.2 m)

watkins-glen.source: iRacing start/finish line (watkinsglen 2021 fullnoloop, Classic Boot; 4 crossings, spread 0.0 m)

brands-hatch.source: iRacing start/finish line (brandshatch grandprix, Grand Prix; 224 crossings, spread 1.4 m; TUM map fitted on 6 iRacing GPS laps, median 2.0 m)

mid-ohio.source: painted start/finish line on the satellite image (Google Maps), white line across the front straight at the starter stand

dubai.source: painted start/finish line on the satellite image (Google Maps), white line across the main straight and the pit lane

sachsenring.source: OpenStreetMap race-control tower on the main straight, projected onto the lap (no painted line visible on the satellite image)

lausitz.source: start/finish mark on the DTM track map (DTM Track Facts), fitted onto the OpenStreetMap raceways (median 2.3 m)

macau.source: TCR Macau 2023 track map (Hyundai Motorsport, web.archive.org copy): chequered start/finish flag, map fitted onto the OSM line (median 2.5 m), about +-20 m
